status: Conditional gate design inputs; exact ASO sequences could not be extracted with available public-content tools and are not invented.

paper.title: Anti-sense oligonucleotide probing as a structural platform for studying ribonucleoprotein complex assembly

probes.name: DNA-RA15
probes.observed: Shorter lag and higher GFP fluorescence in iSAT; authors infer assembly facilitation.
probes.not_established: Postbinding release, defined assembly yield, factor-free assembly, or a quantified benefit beyond the optimized existing assembly route.

probes.name: RA20
probes.target: 23S rRNA helix H1, a long-range interaction
probes.observed: PNA and LNA strongly inhibit iSAT. PNA gives misdocked domain III/VI intermediate RA20-B-c. Biotin-tagged PNA co-localizes with intermediate fractions.
probes.rescue: PNA/LNA prehybridized to complementary RNA before iSAT; this is not removal of a probe already bound to rRNA.

probes.name: PNA-RB0811
probes.observed: Enrichment of E-class particles; authors suggest a possible chaperone effect.
probes.caution: Particles in a later class do not themselves establish active full-length protein synthesis or replacement of modification chemistry.

reported_screening_conditions.rRNA: rrnB transcription initiated after ASO addition
reported_screening_conditions.extract: E. coli S150 provides modification, processing, assembly and translation functions
reported_screening_conditions.ASO_preparation: ASO heated to 95 C for 5 min and added before the rrnB plasmid.
reported_screening_conditions.note: This is a source-condition summary, not a complete recipe. Two source units for tRNA/folinic acid appear suspect and are deliberately not propagated.

purification_observer_cost.interpretation: The published isolation and cryo-EM workflow is an expensive offline observer, not a real-time state-selective release service.

sequence_source.status: Exact links observed; binary contents not obtained.

postbinding_release_operation.operation: A DNA ligation splint with noncomplementary terminal tails is removed from ligated 16S rRNA by complementary DNA at 46 C.
postbinding_release_operation.scope: Observed in purified, ligated rRNA with preserved higher-order structure. Transfer to an ASO-trapped, protein-coated pre-50S complex remains unearned. This condition was independently read by the parent investigator.

natural_partner_isolation.mechanism: Assembly factors/snoRNAs bind l31, the tertiary partner that can trap the j34-35-38 junction; withholding docking allows the local junction to fold before partner release.
natural_partner_isolation.scope: Natural yeast small-subunit biogenesis evidence; not a synthetic bacterial large-subunit gate implementation.
